rules.status: PASS only when the full production chain was executed with the live provider and the isolated database and every expectation matched; BLOCKED when a named external prerequisite prevents execution; NOT_RUN when executable but not yet run. A case is never PASS without an evidence artifact.
rules.expectedOutcome: Answered | Ambiguous | Unsupported | Incomplete | Unauthorized (typed engine outcome; Answered carries expected value/unit/period)
rules.units: Statement items: catalog effective unit (IRRPerShare for item 161). Monthly amounts: MillionIRR. Quantities: Ton. Values are fixture-derived, never model-derived.
rules.periods: Gregorian and Persian (Jalali) dates are both stated; the engine reports the latest reporting period when the question names none, and the answer states that period.

B-CONCEPT-BINDING.action: Approve canonicalConceptBindings (dimension, value form, effective unit) for the concept on the relevant financial-statement-source-items.yaml entries and hierarchy references; regenerate the catalog hash.

B-MONTHLY-MEASURE-REVIEW.action: Approve metric_monthly_production_quantity / metric_monthly_sales_quantity / metric_monthly_sales (review.semanticApproved, review.queryable) and verify metric_monthly_sales_rate unit.

B-PRODUCT-EQUIVALENCE.action: Approve a Feature141:ReviewedProductEquivalenceGroups entry for گندله / گندله سنگ‌آهن with company-scoped product identities.

B-DISCOVERY-SCOPE.action: Configure Feature141:CompanyDiscoveryScopes for the tenant with CompanyCoverageComplete evidence.

B-PLANNER-ALGEBRA.action: Extend planner/validator/compiler for the operator (comparison, ranking, filter, aggregation, multi-measure) with tests; CanonicalIntentCatalogBinding rejects them as Unsupported today.

B-FIXTURE-NOT-SEEDED.action: Seed the proposed fixture block through the runner once the governing approval exists.
